mod.slr_aura.name: SLR Auras
slr_aura.configuration.title: SLR Auras
slr_aura.configuration.flames.enableFlam: Turn the swirling flames on or off. The glow outline, smoke, and eyes stay on.
slr_aura.configuration.enableFlames.tool: Turn the swirling flames on or off. The glow outline, smoke, and eyes stay on.
slr_aura.configuration.flames.forceColor: AUTO uses your Solo Leveling vessel color. Other values force the flame, glow, and eye color.
slr_aura.configuration.forceColor.toolti: AUTO uses your Solo Leveling vessel color. Other values force the flame, glow, and eye color.
slr_aura.configuration.flames.flameCount: How many swirling flames stay around the body. Default is 20.
slr_aura.configuration.flameCount.toolti: How many swirling flames stay around the body. Default is 20.
slr_aura.configuration.flames.flameLengt: How long each flame is. 1.0 is the original length.
slr_aura.configuration.flameLength.toolt: How long each flame is. 1.0 is the original length.
slr_aura.configuration.flames.flameAngle: Flame tilt in degrees. 0 is straight up, 55 is original, 90 is fully outward.
slr_aura.configuration.flameAngle.toolti: Flame tilt in degrees. 0 is straight up, 55 is original, 90 is fully outward.
slr_aura.configuration.outline.thickness: How thick the glow outline is. 2.0 is normal Minecraft. Try 4.0 to 7.0 for thicker.
slr_aura.configuration.thickness.tooltip: How thick the glow outline is. 2.0 is normal Minecraft. Try 4.0 to 7.0 for thicker.
MATCH_AURA uses the same color as the flames. Other values force the smoke color.
slr_aura.configuration.smokeColor.toolti: MATCH_AURA uses the same color as the flames. Other values force the smoke color.
How fast the smoke rises. 1.0 is the original speed.
slr_aura.configuration.smokeSpeed.toolti: How fast the smoke rises. 1.0 is the original speed.
slr_aura.configuration.smoke.smokeSize.t: How big the smoke puffs are. 1.0 is the original size.
slr_aura.configuration.smokeSize.tooltip: How big the smoke puffs are. 1.0 is the original size.
slr_aura.configuration.smoke.smokeTransp: How solid the smoke looks. 1.0 is original, lower is more see-through.
slr_aura.configuration.smokeTransparency: How solid the smoke looks. 1.0 is original, lower is more see-through.
slr_aura.configuration.eyes.tooltip: Star eye position on the face.
slr_aura.configuration.eyes.offsetUp.too: Move both eyes up (positive) or down (negative). 0 is the original position.
slr_aura.configuration.offsetUp.tooltip: Move both eyes up (positive) or down (negative). 0 is the original position.
Move the left eye left (negative) or right (positive). 0 is the original position.
slr_aura.configuration.leftOffsetX.toolt: Move the left eye left (negative) or right (positive). 0 is the original position.
slr_aura.configuration.eyes.rightOffsetX: Move the right eye left (negative) or right (positive). 0 is the original position.
slr_aura.configuration.rightOffsetX.tool: Move the right eye left (negative) or right (positive). 0 is the original position.
